main_text.p: {*} agnoscenda est. Si vero ea humana solùm constitutio & consuetudo foret, ut statuunt Opponentes; non video, cur resurrectionem Domini abnegare velle viderentur, si qui libertate suâ hîc uti mallent, quàm perpetuò observare talem hominum constitutionem & consuetudinem. Quidsi in aliquâ regione, sic commodum videretur, ut tertio, vel quarto quoque die conventûs Ecclesiastici tàm solennes agerentur; & fideles libertate suâ uti mallent, quàm se Ecclesiis aliarum regionum conformare?

6. Neque vacatio ab ordinariis laboribus solùm propter congregationes; sed etiàm propter reliquam Sabbathi praxin, piamque sanctificationem, suscipienda. Sic opus ab opere discernendum per suos dies, juxta Præceptum Dei Morale.

7. Patres circa familiam, Magistratus circa populum, optimè & cum fructû maximè salutari exercent potestatem suam, ubi id faciunt juxta Præceptum Dei, ejusque observationem urgent. Sic penetrat ista potestas ad conscientiam: sic Deo verè præstatur obedientia, & non tantùm ho
{*} The opening mark is a printed ornament or reference sign, transcribed as printed.

page.notes: The first line begins with a printed mark (ornament/sign) before the comma, rendered as {*}. Last line ends with "ho" (catchword-like continuation, printed as the last line). Some letters in the scan are blurred; "s" long s rendered as s throughout. Possible doubtful readings: "{*}" at start of page; "suscipienda." and "ho" at end.
